item.title: Expel: Technical Account Manager
item.description:
Headquarters: Remote

You've spent your career helping security teams get more from their technology. You understand what it takes to operationalize security tooling across an enterprise, and your credibility with customers comes from technical depth and hands-on problem solving. As a Technical Account Manager at Expel, you're the dedicated technical advisor for a portfolio of enterprise security programs. You drive platform adoption, deepen integrations into customers' security ecosystems, and ensure they get full value from their investment in Expel's managed detection and response service. 

You partner closely with Customer Success Managers, who own the commercial relationship and retention outcomes. Your role is to deliver technical depth and expertise that frees CSMs to focus on strategic and executive relationships. When incidents occur, you own the technical response coordination with customers. When integrations or troubleshooting challenges arise, you work to resolve them, escalating to senior team members when needed. 

Your success is measured by technical value realization within your accounts: adoption metrics, time-to-value, customer technical health scores, and your contribution to retention outcomes alongside your CSM partners. You work with enterprise accounts where the technical complexity and investment level warrant dedicated technical advisory support. 

What Expel can do for you

  • Extend your network of security leaders across a wide variety of industries 
  • Plug you in to customer missions that matter: keeping people safe and saving lives 
  • Deepen your expertise in the security market, and in particular security operations 
  • Set you up to flex your consultative risk management and security strategy muscles 
  • Provide access to, hands down, the best security operations platform on the market 
  • Help you continue to gain experience with security technologies and methodologies

What you can do for Expel

  • Drive platform adoption and technical health metrics for assigned accounts, ensuring customers fully leverage Expel's capabilities 
  • Build deep technical relationships with security practitioners, architects, and technical leaders who influence platform adoption and integration decisions 
  • Advise customers on security program improvements, detection strategies, and how to get more value from their technology investments 
  • Help customers mature their use of Expel over time, expanding integrations and optimizing their configuration. Provide technical content and support for CSM-led quarterly business reviews 
  • Handle troubleshooting and integration challenges, partnering with TSEs, Detection & Response, Engineering, and Product teams as needed; escalate complex issues to senior TAMs 
  • Own technical incident response coordination with customers, managing the technical aspects of security incidents while CSMs handle executive communication 
  • Identify technical expansion opportunities (new integrations, additional coverage) 
  • Support and learn from more senior team members on the most complex technical challenges

What you should bring with you

  • 5+ years of security industry experience, majority in consultative customer-facing roles 
  • Deep technical expertise in two or more security product spaces (EDR, NDR, SIEM, Cloud security, IAM, etc.) and associated detection strategies 
  • Experience in customer-facing technical roles (solutions engineering, professional services, technical consulting). Understanding of enterprise security operations and the challenges security teams face 
  • Strong consultative skills; leads with listening, understands customer context before recommending solutions. Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to varied audiences, from SOC analysts to security directors

Additional Notes

The base salary range for this role is between $114,300 USD and $165,700 USD, plus variable compensation and equity. While the full salary band reflects our long-term compensation framework, we're primarily targeting candidates between $130,000 and $155,000 based on experience, skills, and market data. This role has an 85/15 pay mix, resulting in targeted on-track earnings (OTE) of approximately $152,941 to $182,352 USD.

We believe in paying transparently and equitably. Your salary will ultimately be based on factors such as your experience, skills, team equity, and market data. You’ll also be eligible for unlimited PTO (which we model and encourage), work location flexibility, up to 24 weeks of parental leave, and really excellent health benefits.

We're only hiring those authorized to work in the United States.

We're an Equal Opportunity Employer: You will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability.

We’ll ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform crucial job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please let us know if you need accommodation of any kind.

#LI-remote

Salary Range
$114,300—$165,700 USD

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/expel-technical-account-manager

item.title: Expel: Systems Engineer
item.description:
Headquarters: Remote

Are you looking for a role where you're critical to every part of the business? Do you want to help ensure that our teams deliver software so that our analysts can deliver service to our customers? How about being a crucial part of making sure our internal teams operate efficiently?

You're not afraid of new technology. In fact, you love diving in and figuring out how it works. Whether it's a successful launch or a few bumps in the road, you're always up for a challenge. Balancing multiple projects at once is no easy feat, but when everything clicks into place, there's nothing quite like that sense of satisfaction.

The best part of the job? Seeing someone use a capability you've built and hearing them exclaim, "Wow, I can't believe how easy that was." You care about the success of your colleagues and take pride in helping them achieve it.

As a cloud-based IT organization, we're breaking the traditional mold and thinking creatively about how we can make the day-to-day life of our employees simple. We're always looking for innovative solutions, and we need someone with the wit and determination to help us achieve our goals.

In this role, you'll keep Expel's IT infrastructure and services secure and highly available, from our cloud platforms all the way down to the equipment in our conference rooms. You'll manage access across the employee lifecycle, own large cross-functional projects from beginning to end, and take manual work out of how we operate before anyone feels the friction. It's based onsite at our Herndon, Virginia headquarters, so you'll also be the person who makes sure the technology people walk up and touch works exactly like it should.

If you're up for the challenge, we want to hear from you!

What Expel Can Do For You

  • Provide the autonomy to define problems and propose solutions.
  • Deliver never-ending opportunities to tackle business problems.
  • Give you real ownership of large cross-functional projects, end to end.
  • Surround you with a team of problem solvers.
  • Ensure you get support, mentoring, and feedback to make you successful.

What You Can Do For Expel

  • Manage and maintain IT systems in a cloud first environment.
  • Provide friendly and unflappable technical support.
  • Make sure new hires have the accounts, access, and hardware they need on day one, and that access goes away promptly when people leave.
  • Be the point of contact for the systems and services you own.
  • Own large cross-functional projects from beginning to end.
  • Collaborate with multi-functional teams to identify integration issues, solve errors, and optimize performance.
  • Proactively find opportunities for improvement and build automations that streamline operations and reduce manual work.
  • Apply AI tooling, like Claude and Gemini, to accelerate day-to-day work.
  • Manage IT-owned technology at Expel's HQ, including network equipment, conference room and AV equipment, kiosk computers, and other shared-space systems.
  • Keep people in the loop on service disruptions and changes.
  • Work alongside our security team to protect our information.
  • Contribute to the team's roadmap and work in two week sprints against quarterly and yearly goals.
  • Build and routinely update documentation on automations, configurations, and operating procedures.

What You Should Bring With You

  • Proficiency managing core enterprise SaaS products such as Okta, Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, Jira, Confluence, and Microsoft 365.
  • Experience automating tasks and integrating systems using platforms like Workato, Okta Workflows, or Microsoft Power Automate.
  • Experience with AI platforms like Anthropic Claude and Google Gemini, including prompt engineering and connecting systems through emerging standards like the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
  • Knowledge of concepts like SAML, OIDC, SCIM, REST APIs, webhooks, JWT, and OAuth 2.0.
  • Knowledge of programming and scripting languages like Python, Bash, PowerShell, and Ruby.
  • macOS and Windows operating system administration skills, including experience with MDMs like Jamf and Intune.
  • Familiarity with conference room AV and shared-space technology, like Zoom Rooms and Neat devices.
  • Knowledge of Cisco Meraki and basic networking concepts like VLANs, DNS, DHCP, and wireless networking.
  • Strong project management skills, especially on large cross-functional projects.
  • Capacity to balance a mix of urgent, interrupt-driven tasks and project-level work.
  • Excellent customer service and communication skills, written and verbal, with a habit of treating colleagues like customers.
  • Adept at translating technical concepts and communicating to non-technical audiences.
  • Outstanding problem solving abilities, with a desire to get to the root of sophisticated issues.
  • Well-versed in IT operations best practices.
  • 5+ years of professional experience with IT, 2+ of which were in an engineering or sysadmin capacity.
  • A college degree or credible panache.

Additional Notes

This is a fully remote role open to candidates anywhere in the U.S. While proximity to our Herndon, Virginia headquarters is a plus for occasional onsite needs, it is not required.

The base salary range for this role is between $93,900 USD and $136,200 USD + bonus eligibility and equity. While the full salary band reflects our long-term compensation framework, we're primarily targeting candidates between $105,000 and $125,000 based on experience, skills, and market data.

You’ll also be eligible for unlimited PTO (which we model and encourage), work location flexibility, up to 24 weeks of parental leave, and really excellent health benefits.

We’re only hiring those authorized to work in the United States. We do not currently sponsor immigration visas.

We're an Equal Opportunity Employer: You'll receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability.

We’ll ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please let us know if you need accommodation of any kind.

item.title: Current: Senior Product Designer (Webflow) Temp to Perm
item.description:
Headquarters: Remote (US)

Senior Product Designer (Webflow)

At Current

At Current, Senior Product Designers (Webflow) lead the design and delivery of engaging digital experiences across multiple client engagements. You'll partner closely with cross-functional teams across strategy, production, engineering, and client services to create thoughtful, user-centered websites that are both beautifully designed and expertly built in Webflow.

Senior Product Designers are strategic, hands-on creators. You're equally comfortable conducting UX discovery, designing polished experiences in Figma, and building production-ready websites in Webflow. You own projects from concept through launch, partnering with engineering only when advanced custom development or integrations are required.

What You'll Do

  • Lead UX and visual design across websites and digital experiences for multiple client engagements
  • Partner with strategy, production, engineering, and client stakeholders to define user experience and creative direction
  • Create user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs in Figma
  • Design and build responsive, production-ready websites directly in Webflow
  • Develop scalable design systems, reusable components, and CMS structures in Webflow
  • Translate business goals into intuitive, accessible, and conversion-focused digital experiences
  • Collaborate with engineers on advanced functionality, integrations, and custom development when needed
  • Optimize websites for usability, accessibility, responsiveness, and SEO
  • Conduct UX reviews and recommend improvements based on best practices and user insights
  • Stay current on UX trends, accessibility standards, and evolving Webflow capabilities

What You'll Bring

  • 5–7 years of UX/UI, Product, or Digital Design experience, ideally within an agency or consulting environment
  • 2+ years building production-ready websites in Webflow
  • Advanced proficiency with Figma and Webflow
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end ownership from UX strategy through final Webflow implementation
  • Experience building scalable Webflow websites using CMS Collections, Components, and design systems
  • Experience with Client-First methodology, Relume, and Finsweet Attributes
  • Strong understanding of UX, responsive design, accessibility (WCAG), and information architecture
  • Working knowledge of HTML and CSS with the ability to partner effectively with engineers
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Lottie, GSAP, or interactive animations
  • Experience integrating Webflow with HubSpot, Memberstack, Airtable, Zapier, Make, or similar platforms
  • Experience using analytics or A/B testing to inform design decisions
  • Familiarity with Jira, Workfront, or similar project management tools
  • Experience working within Agile delivery environments

Why Current

At Current, we believe the best digital work happens when strategy, design, production, and technology operate as one team. We partner with ambitious brands to create digital experiences that are thoughtful, scalable, and built to drive real impact.

We're a remote-first agency with teams across the U.S., working collaboratively across websites, platforms, campaigns, CRM ecosystems, and digital product experiences. Our environment is fast-paced, highly collaborative, and built for people who enjoy solving complex technical challenges alongside smart, supportive teammates.

This is a temporary-to-permanent opportunity. The role will begin as a hourly position, with the opportunity to transition into a full-time employee based on business needs and individual performance.

The target hourly compensation range for the temporary portion of this role is $45.00 - $65.00 per hour. If converted to full-time, the target range of base compensation for this role is $100,000 - $125,000 annually. Actual compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors, including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and location.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/current-senior-product-designer-webflow-temp-to-perm

item.title: Current: Freelance Marketo Email Engineer
item.description:
Headquarters: Remote (US)

 

About the Role

As a Freelance Marketo Email Specialist, you'll build, test, and launch email programs in Marketo for a range of client brands. This is a hands-on, execution-only contract role with no leadership or management responsibilities. You'll take approved briefs and turn them into working programs, building responsive templates and modules, setting up smart lists and flows, and making sure every send goes out right the first time. You know Marketo well enough to spot a broken token, a misfired trigger, or a segmentation gap before it reaches a subscriber. You'll take direction from our internal team, get up to speed fast, and deliver accurate builds on schedule with minimal oversight.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and launch email programs in Marketo, including one-off sends, nurture streams, engagement programs, and triggered campaigns.
  • Develop and maintain responsive email templates and modular components in HTML and CSS, using Marketo's template syntax, variables, and editable sections.
  • Set up smart lists, smart campaigns, flow steps, and segmentations that match the targeting and logic in the brief.
  • Use tokens, dynamic content, and snippets to personalize emails and keep programs easy to clone and reuse.
  • QA every email before launch: rendering across clients and devices (e.g. Litmus or Email on Acid), links, tokens, personalization fallbacks, and list logic.
  • Manage program structure, naming conventions, and folder organization so client instances stay clean and easy to navigate.
  • Build to the brief and requirements provided, and flag any gaps or errors in the request before they become problems in the send.
  • Communicate status, timelines, and blockers clearly with your internal point of contact.
  • Document builds and processes so other team members can pick up, update, or reuse the work.
  • Follow established Marketo, deliverability, and accessibility standards on every build.

Qualifications

Required

  • At least 3 years of hands-on experience building and deploying email campaigns in Marketo Engage.
  • Strong working knowledge of Marketo programs, smart lists, smart campaigns, tokens, snippets, and dynamic content.
  • Proficiency in HTML and CSS for email, including responsive and hybrid coding and Marketo template syntax.
  • Experience with email rendering and QA tools such as Litmus or Email on Acid.
  • A detail-oriented QA process that catches errors in logic, links, and personalization before launch.
  • Experience working across multiple clients or Marketo instances, adapting quickly to different setups and conventions.
  • Clear, proactive communication, including flagging risks early and giving accurate time estimates.
  • Ability to work independently, take direction well, and hit deadlines across overlapping requests.

Preferred

  • Marketo Certified Expert or Marketo Certified Associate.
  • Familiarity with email deliverability, authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), and list hygiene.
  • Experience with email accessibility standards (e.g. WCAG).
  • Experience with lead scoring, lifecycle programs, and Marketo–Salesforce CRM sync.
  • Experience with other marketing automation platforms (e.g. Salesforce Marketing Cloud, HubSpot, Braze).
  • Agency or consulting experience.

Why Current

At Current, we believe the best digital work happens when strategy, design, production, and technology operate as one team. We partner with ambitious brands to create digital experiences that are thoughtful, scalable, and built to drive real impact.

We're a remote-first agency with teams across the US, working collaboratively across websites, platforms, campaigns, CRM ecosystems, and digital product experiences. Our environment is fast-paced, highly collaborative, and built for people who enjoy solving complex technical challenges alongside smart, supportive teammates.

You'll have the opportunity to work across a variety of clients and technologies, and contribute to meaningful digital experiences within a growing agency environment.

This is a freelance, contract engagement. The target hourly rate for this role is $50 - $70 per hour. Actual rate is influenced by a wide array of factors, including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and location.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/current-freelance-marketo-email-engineer

item.title: Flexport: Senior Security Engineer, Detection & Response
item.description:
Headquarters: U.S. Remote

About Flexport: 

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. 

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

What you'll do

There is no MSSP and no tier-1 queue here. Detection & Response engineers own their detections end to end: you write them, you tune them, and your team is paged when they fire. The security team is spread across the globe with a follow-the-sun pager rotation so nobody is paged at 3am local.

The adversaries are real. The business is growing fast and the threat surface is growing with it. Defining the necessary telemetry is part of the job.

Detection engineering

  • Build and tune detections across endpoint, identity, SaaS, and cloud, treating them as software: version-controlled, peer-reviewed, and shipped through the same CI/CD practices the rest of engineering uses.
  • Track detection quality as measured quantities: coverage against MITRE ATT&CK, precision, time-to-detect. We don’t build-and-forget here.

Response & automation

  • Own incident response: triage, contain, remediate, and write the retrospective that turns the incident into a systemic fix.
  • Build automation that removes toil from investigations, and partner closely with the US-based team so context carries across time zones instead of getting lost at handoff.

Telemetry & partnership

  • Define telemetry requirements for new systems before they ship, working with infrastructure and product teams to close visibility gaps rather than discovering them during an incident.
  • Threat hunt proactively across the estate, converting hypotheses into either new detections or documented coverage.

You Should Have

  • Typically 5–8 years of experience in detection engineering, incident response, or threat hunting, with real hands-on time writing and tuning detections. We care more about what you've built than the exact number.
  • Proficiency in at least one programming language (Python, Go, or similar) and comfort writing production-grade detection and automation code.
  • Experience with a modern SIEM or detection pipeline (Panther, Elastic, Splunk, or similar). What matters is that you've shipped and tuned detection logic in production.
  • Practical incident response experience: you've led or played a major role in triaging and closing out real security incidents.

Nice to have

  • Experience treating detections as code with CI/CD, peer review, and staged rollout.
  • Experience defining telemetry contracts for systems before they ship, rather than retrofitting logging after an incident.
  • A track record of critically evaluating and verifying AI-assisted work - testing, source-checking, validation - rather than trusting agent output by default. If you haven’t already spotted the em dashes in this job description and already thought about where the hiring manager (hi!) has put hands on keyboard and compared that to where they let the LLM watermarks through, you might not be the right person for the job.
  • Familiarity with cloud-native and Kubernetes telemetry.
  • Experience with fraud or financial-crime detection patterns.

How we work

  • We stay closely aligned with teammates on other continents via Slack, video, and async docs.
  • We have the latest hardware and software, including frontier AI models on day one.
  • We're agile, but not dogmatic. Teams decide how they work best.

Why this role is special

  • You own your detections end to end, no MSSP, no tier-1 queue, no handing your work to someone else to triage.
  • The consequences here are physical, not abstract: a containment decision can stop a customs filing or freight actually moving, which makes the stakes concrete in a way a SaaS control plane rarely is.
  • You'll inherit a real, established estate with legacy telemetry gaps to close, genuinely underexplored surface area, not a well-mined problem.
